# Vendor electrode montages

Canonical electrode coordinates, taken from the cap manufacturers themselves.

`read_montage.m` reads these directly:

```matlab
eloc = read_montage('channel_locs/vendor/brainvision/AC-21.bvef');   % standard 10-20
plot_topo([], eloc, 'electrodes', 'ptslabels');
```

## Why these files are not in git

**Nothing here is committed** — see `.gitignore`. None of these vendors grants
redistribution: the EGI files are freely downloadable but carry no license
grant, and the Brain Products files sit behind a customer login. This repo is
public and BSD-3, so the files stay local. Fetch your own copies as below.

## Prerau Lab — `prerau/`

Montages measured here rather than published by a vendor. **These are committed**
— they are our own data, so the redistribution problem above does not apply, and
`.gitignore` in this directory re-includes `prerau/*.bvef`. Without that
re-inclusion, rebuilding the library from a fresh clone would silently drop them.

| File | Channels | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `NSS-64.bvef` | 64 | Cohort-average positions for the NSS 64-channel cap |

`NSS-64` is the mean of 21 Polhemus digitizations from 11 subjects, averaged within
subject first so the 10 two-night subjects do not count twice, and built by
`fif_to_eloc`/`nss_fif_to_eloc` from the raw `.fif` files. Coordinates are Neuromag
head coordinates: the origin is where the nasion projects onto the line joining the
preauricular points.

Two conventions of this cap are worth stating, because neither is guessable from the
file. Electrodes are labeled `1`..`64` — the cap numbers its holders rather than
naming them, so there are no 10-20 labels. And the reference electrode, which is
digitized but is not a recorded data channel, is **omitted**; it sits on the anterior
midline ringed by electrodes 5, 11, 36 and 41.

The file carries `Nz`/`LPA`/`RPA` so `read_montage` can infer the axis convention.
They are needed: with numeric labels there is not a single 10-20 name to orient from,
and `read_montage` errors rather than guess. They are dropped before projection and
never become channels.

`read_montage` warns that the projected cap is 1.53:1 anisotropic, against the 1.1-1.2:1
it expects of a vendor net. That is the cap and not the averaging — individual sessions
measure 1.45-1.62 — and it comes from the cap reaching only +0.33 anteriorly where an
actiCAP 64 reaches +0.48. Maximum electrode radius (0.64) and the number of electrodes
past the head rim (7) are in line with the vendor caps.

## Brain Products / EasyCap — `brainvision/`

`.bvef` (XML, spherical theta/phi on a unit sphere). **103 files, the complete
Brain Products catalog**: actiCAP (AC/AP/AS/ASG/ASP/CACS/CMA/CLA/CLACS),
BrainCap (BC) including MR/MR3/MEG/TMS/Sleep, LiveCap (LC), R-Net (RNP), and
Xpress Twist. 13 to 256 channels.

Notable ones:

| File | Channels | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `AC-21.bvef` | 21 | **The standard 10-20**, plus TP9/TP10 mastoids |
| `AC-64.bvef` | 64 | Default for 64-channel data |
| `BC-256.bvef` | 256 | Largest; adds 10-5 intermediates (AFpz, FCCz, I1/I2 ...) |
| `BC-SL-*.bvef` | 32/64/128 | BrainCap **Sleep** — adds EOG1/2, EMG1/2/3, ECG |
| `BC-MRS-15.bvef` | 15 | Clinical sleep montage: F3 F4 C3 C4 O1 O2 + EOG/EMG/ECG |

Source: <https://www.brainproducts.com/downloads/cap-montages/> — all zips are
public, no login. The download URLs reject requests without a browser
`User-Agent` and `Referer` and serve a login page instead, which is misleading:
the files are not actually gated. Fetch with:

```bash
curl -L -A "Mozilla/5.0" -e "https://www.brainproducts.com/downloads/cap-montages/" \
     -o cap.zip "https://www.brainproducts.com/download/<name>-zip/"
```

Retrieved 2026-07-16. Generated by "EasyCap Configurator".

**Geometry is name-determined.** Across the 96 electrode names shared between
actiCAPs, positions agree to 1e-16 — an `F3` is in the same place in every cap.
What distinguishes one cap file from another is which subset of names it carries
and in what channel order, not where the electrodes are. So the per-cap files
matter for channel *ordering*; they add no new geometry beyond the union.

**Filenames repeat across zips but never conflict**: 159 extracted files reduce
to 103 unique names, and every duplicated name has byte-identical content
(checked). A flat directory is safe.

### Deriving the clinical montages

`AC-21` contains the full standard 10-20 (19/19 verified) and the AASM clinical
six as a subset — no separate file needed:

```matlab
eloc  = read_montage('channel_locs/vendor/brainvision/AC-21.bvef');
six   = eloc(ismember({eloc.labels}, {'F3','F4','C3','C4','O1','O2'}));
std19 = eloc(~ismember({eloc.labels}, {'TP9','TP10'}));
```

Note the modern names: `T7/T8/P7/P8` are the old `T3/T4/T5/T6`, and `TP9/TP10`
stand in for the old `A1/A2` earlobes.

## EGI (Magstim EGI) — `egi/`

`.sfp` (plain text `label x y z`, RAS, with FidNz/FidT9/FidT10 fiducials).

| File | Channels | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `AdultAverageNet32_v1.sfp` | 33 | HydroCel GSN, adult 18+ |
| `AdultAverageNet64_v1.sfp` | 65 | |
| `AdultAverageNet128_v1.sfp` | 129 | |
| `AdultAverageNet256_v1.sfp` | 257 | |

Counts include the vertex reference `Cz`. Age-specific variants (0–2y, 2–9y,
9–18y) are on the same page and matter for developmental work — the average
head geometry differs.

Source: <https://www.egi.com/knowledge-center/item/71-sensor-position-files-for-visualizing-data-in-third-party-software>
Direct: `https://www.egi.com/images/kb/Sensor_Position_.sfp_files/GS_3_.sfp/AdultAverageNet<N>_v1.sfp.zip`

Retrieved 2026-07-16. Freely downloadable, no login. No explicit license stated.

These are *average head* coordinates, not idealized spheres, so their electrodes
sit ~12–14% off the best-fit sphere center of the electrode set. That is normal
and `read_montage` is calibrated to accept it.

## ANT Neuro — not present

ANT does not publish waveguard coordinates for download; both documented paths
(`ant-neuro.com/download/misc`, `.../products/waveguard/electrode-layouts`) 404
as of 2026-07-16. Obtain `.elc` files either from an ASA / eego install under
`<installation folder>\data\electrodes\`, or from ANT support.

`read_montage` already parses `.elc`, so a file dropped into `ant/` will work.

Third-party waveguard `.elc` files circulate (e.g. markspan.github.io/Waveguard)
but state no provenance and are **not** from ANT — avoid them for a canonical
montage.

## BioSemi — not present

Not currently needed, but freely available with no login if it ever is:
<https://www.biosemi.com/download/Cap_coords_all.xls> — one sheet per cap
(16/32/64/128/160/256), with both spherical and Cartesian columns and a
head-circumference input. Note its own convention: inclination 0 at Cz, azimuth
measured from T7/T8 rather than the nose.
